node.title: Grand MCA: determine delta* (emca <= 2^-128)
node.statement: For each admissible C: exhibit adjacent a with B_C(a-1) > floor(q_line/2^128) >= B_C(a), all conventions printed. RATE SCOPE (amber audit 2026-07-06): the wired premises deliver the CLEAN RATES (1/4, 1/8, 1/16); the rate-1/2 instance of this claim is additionally conditional on rate_half_band_closure (red). The previous unscoped wording over-claimed. || ROW-SIZE SCOPE (k_extremal audit 2026-08-10, E7 SCOPE SEAM — FLAGGED, NOT RESOLVED): 'admissible C' is the descriptor family (background/nodes/descriptor/proof.md:3-8: q=p^e, n=2^s, k=rho*n, checked against q<2^256, k<=2^40, n | q-1). k <= 2^40 is an UPPER CAP, not a pin, so at rate 1/2 the family is the 41 row sizes n=2^s, k=2^(s-1), s=1..41 (per admissible field), NOT the single row n=2^41, k=2^40. The rate-1/2 premise this statement is declared conditional on, rate_half_band_closure, is posed at n=2^41, k=2^40 and locates nothing at s<41. No node establishes k=2^40 as extremal and no node reduces s<41 rate-half rows to it. The rate-1/2 instance of this claim is therefore presently carried only at s=41; s<=40 is UNCOVERED. Owner: a new reduction node (candidate poses in notes/pilots_20260810/k_extremal/DRAFT_SCOPE_FLAGS.md D3.2; POSE 3 per-s family re-pose ADOPTED 2026-08-10 — user-delegated coordinator ruling; node retrofit queued with the next mint wave. The ABF26 'sufficiently large |F|' proviso is RESOLVED NEGATIVE against the primary source: abf26 = Arnon-Boneh-Fenzi, 'Open Problems in List Decoding and Correlated Agreement' (2026-04-08), page-5 grand-challenge box — the proviso reads 'assuming |F| is sufficiently large so that such a delta*_C exists', a field-size well-definedness clause, not a row-size exclusion; the accompanying text quantifies 'for every choice of F, L, and k' with 'mostly interested in ... k <= 2^40, and |F| < 2^256', a cap over the family. The HOLE therefore STANDS and no rules question is needed. See notes/pilots_20260810/k_extremal/ABF26_RESOLUTION.md.)
